description:
Key Requirements:
• Expert level work experience in PowerShell (5+ years’ experience).
• Work experience in Object Oriented design and implementation (2+)
• Knowledge of PowerShell Desired State Configuration is a plus.
• Work knowledge of C# and .NET framework.
• Work knowledge of RESTful web services is a plus. 
• Work knowledge of Windows Server Management. 
• Work knowledge of Agile methodology.
• Excellent troubleshooting skills at various levels of code complexity.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills to successfully engage with customers and colleagues.
• Track record of ramping up quickly in an evolving and challenging role.




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
